errors.text: The proposed Nb addition and arc-melting/annealing route does not reconstruct the target intervention of high-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering.
The claim of retaining ductility is unsupported and is directly weakened by E3, which reports decreasing plasticity as the hard Nb-rich Laves-phase fraction increases.
No quantitative hardness, strength, or ductility change relative to a compositionally and thermomechanically defined baseline is predicted.
The 1–3 wt% boundary and 500 °C annealing conditions appear to be transferred from Mo evidence E4 and are not validated for Nb.

Several citations are compositionally indirect or internally mismatched, so they do not establish that the proposed Nb treatment under the stated conditions produces the claimed balance of properties.
